text:
maya: heads-up — our PR-eval gate flaked twice this morning, looks like metrics noise from the gha reporter

emma: saw that, the CI job passes but the gating dashboard shows metric spikes and then the rollup rejects the run :grimacing:

jamal: long story short: per-shard reporters emit a zillion tiny time-series points. the rollup job currently sums them in near-real-time and the PR gate uses the raw series for the threshold check. race + jitter => flakiness

alex: is this the same artifact dedupe issue we had where multiple runner retries uploaded the same metrics?

jamal: related. two things: (1) duplicate uploads on retry, (2) the aggregator doesn't debounce within a window so transient spikes bypass smoothing

maya: proposal: change gha workflow to post shard-level metrics to an aggregator endpoint that does a 60s debounce+rollup, then emit a single rollup metric for the PR gate. that keeps worker-side logic simple and centralizes smoothing

emma: +1. that also helps dashboards because we can expose both raw and rollup but gate on rollup only

ci-bot: reminder — nightly-evals scheduled at 02:00 UTC will be affected if we switch endpoints; set a canary first :robot_face:

lucas: canary plan: enable aggregator for 10% of PRs (label: eval-canary) for 48h, monitor false positives and latency. if stable, flip default

maya: minimal GH action change looks like this:

```yaml
# .github/workflows/eval-report.yml (snippet)
- name: Report eval metrics
  uses: actions/http-client@v1
  with:
    url: "https://ci-aggregator.redwood.ai/v1/metrics" # new endpoint
    method: POST
    headers: '{"content-type":"application/json","authorization":"Bearer ${{ secrets.CI_METRICS_KEY }}"}'
    body: ${{ steps.collect-metrics.outputs.json }}
```

maya: aggregator behavior (high-level):
- ingest per-shard payloads
- dedupe by artifact_id + run_id within 5m
- buffer events for up to 60s and compute rollup stats (sum, median, p90)
- write rollup series tagged `eval_rollup=true` and emit single PR-gate datapoint

jamal: here's a tiny debounce prototype (bash) that runners could fallback to if aggregator not available:

```bash
# debounce-uploader.sh
payload_file="$1"
run_id="$2"
lockfile="/tmp/metrics-${run_id}.lock"
# atomic touch
exec 9>"$lockfile" || exit 1
flock -n 9 || exit 0  # another uploader is debouncing
sleep 60
cat "$payload_file" | curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_METRICS_KEY" -d @- https://ci-aggregator.redwood.ai/v1/metrics
rm -f "$lockfile"
```

emma: that lockfile trick is hacky but effective for quick wins. prefer server-side solution though

alex: question: will this change the gating window? customers rely on sub-minute rollbacks in some canaries

maya: gating semantics unchanged for callers — PR gate will still evaluate after job completes. only internal smoothing and dedupe differ. latency add ~60s worst-case for edge bursts, but stable runs should be immediate as aggregator flushes quickly once baseline stable

lucas: dashboard work: update the gating dashboard to show both `eval_raw_count` and `eval_rollup_count` with a small sparkline and an annotation when canary label present

jamal: also need to fix our GH action retries to avoid re-upload storm: set `max-attempts: 2` and jitter backoff in `actions/checkout` and the report step

emma: i'll open the GH Actions PR to switch the endpoint + add attempt limits. assigning to myself. planning to include the canary label check.

maya: thanks. can someone own the aggregator endpoint? need infra + infra-sre pairing to deploy the service behind auth and rate limits

alex: i can pair with infra-sre this week — will create an infra ticket and a simple deployment plan (k8s service, HPA, 1 replica min for canary)

ci-bot: created incident/ops ticket #INC-2026-54 for aggregator deployment (assigned: alex, infra-sre)

lucas: last note — instrument a regression test in our eval-ci that deliberately emits jitter and asserts the rollup stays within tolerance. that'll catch future regressions in the aggregator algorithm

maya: perfect. next steps: (1) emma PR for gha changes, (2) alex + infra to stand up aggregator canary, (3) jamal to add debounced regression test, (4) 48h canary run, (5) flip default if stable

emma: starting the PR now, ETA EOD today. ping me for reviews :raised_hands:

jamal: i'll sketch the regression harness and push a quick test branch tomorrow

maya: thanks team, keeping this in the milestone. will post status updates in #eng-ml during canary

lucas: :thumbsup:

ci-bot: deploy pipeline notice — staging cluster autoscaler will scale up if aggregator CPU > 65% :rocket:

emma: quick Q: do we want to version the rollup metric name (e.g., `eval_rollup_v2`) so dashboards don't break on hotfixes?

maya: yes, prefix with v2 for the new algorithm. dashboards + alerts must reference the v2 metric during canary and switch after flip

alex: ack — i'll include a short migration doc in the infra ticket

maya: that's it for now.
